While the heat will be the dominant story, we are watching for a slight increase in rain chances towards the end of the week. For now, though, it's all about the sunshine and warmth.

If you're planning on heading out today, be sure to stay hydrated and take breaks in the shade, especially if you're walking around the city or exploring areas like the National Assembly complex.

As we look ahead to the coming days, the high pressure system that's been dominating our weather will continue to keep things warm and dry.
